title: Fix three bugs in a text processor module
description: Three text-processing functions have bugs: word_count uses split(' ') and counts empty strings, reverse_words reverses characters not words, capitalize_words uppercases everything.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/textproc.py:
1. `word_count`: use `text.split()` (no arg) to handle multiple spaces; return 0 for empty/whitespace-only strings
2. `reverse_words`: use `' '.join(reversed(text.split()))` to reverse word order
3. `capitalize_words`: use `text.title()` or `' '.join(w.capitalize() for w in text.split())`
All 5 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
